name: Fondazione Morra Greco
funding: Regione Campania supported the restoration of the palazzo under the FESR 2007-2013 programme and joined the foundation's Board of Directors.

name: Madre · museo d'arte contemporanea Donnaregina
funding: Fondazione Donnaregina, funded by the Campania region.

name: Centro Pecci
funding: Funded by the City of Prato and the Tuscany region.

name: Castello di Rivoli Museo d Arte Contemporanea
funding: €6.5M. Regione Piemonte, Città di Torino, Fondazione CRT, Compagnia di San Paolo.

name: Galleria Nazionale d'Arte Moderna e Contemporanea
funding: Ministry of Culture state museum. The ministry paid EUR 1.5M for its 2024-25 Futurism show. Main sponsors were Autostrade per l'Italia and Enel; Ferrovie dello Stato and Unipol also sponsored.

name: MACRO (Museo d'Arte Contemporanea di Roma)
funding: €3.5M budget. Roma Capitale municipal cultural council and Azienda Speciale Palaexpo public agency.

name: MAXXI
funding: Ministry of Culture EUR 14.0M in 2025, Regione Lazio 350k, Enel 600k as a promoter member, sponsors KME and Bulgari. Eni pays EUR 48,750 for archive work.

name: Castello di Rivoli
funding: 2023 income €5.6M: public grants €3.2M (Regione Piemonte, Turin, Rivoli), private grants €1.3M (Fondazione CRT, CRC, Compagnia di San Paolo); Intesa Sanpaolo and Lavazza Group are partners.

name: Fondazione Sandretto Re Rebaudengo
funding: Private foundation of Patrizia Sandretto Re Rebaudengo; family links to Asja Energy (renewables).

name: PAV - Parco Arte Vivente
funding: Comune di Torino paid 100.000,00 euro for 2024 activity and awarded 100.000,00 for 2025. Regione Piemonte paid 28.840,00 euro as balance for 2024 and awarded 64.271,00 for 2025.
